column1: # DRAGON BALL FighterZ (SDK 4, Unreal pak v11). Began as the NSP script's provisional profile; the texture
# keys below were added after a play session showed character/UI textures black or miscoloured (GitHub issue
# #1432): the game writes its DXT textures into a CPU_UNCACHED pool and reads them back, so the host must
# upload them from storage (first uploads went from 0 to 2590 once tex_flush_upload was on).
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# the decoded shader code archives: the engine's global shaders and the game's material shaders
# The game's DXT (0x41 RGB_DXT1 / 0x44 RGBA_DXT5 / 0x45 DXT1_SRGB / 0x48 DXT5_SRGB) and 2D textures live in
# CPU_UNCACHED pools (flags 0xe2). It writes them through the CPU (no WriteTexels, no packaged layout) and
# never flushes; without these two keys every such texture is GPU-only and reads stale (black blocks, wrong
# colours, black story-mode cutscenes). tex_flush_upload uploads a texture from its pool storage when it is
# first used; tex_dirty_upload re-uploads one whose pages the CPU wrote after creation. Same pair as Tears of
# the Kingdom, Breath of the Wild and ten other profiles (issue #1432).
